newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian police arrest Greek wanted for murder.
newsitem.headline: Italian police arrest Greek wanted for murder.

text.p: Italian police said on Saturday they had arrested the captain of a Greek cargo ship after discovering he was wanted for the murder of two Jamaican stowaways in 1993.
Joannis Mikalos, 61, was arrested in this southern Sicilian port where his ship the "Tasos" had been due to pick up a cargo of plastics, police said.

A routine border check showed the Greek captain was wanted by international police agency Interpol. A Colombian court had found him guilty of double murder and attempted double murder in 1993, police said.

They said Mikalos, after finding four Jamaican stowaways aboard his ship in 1993, put them on a raft off Colombia. Two died and the others reported the incident to authorities in the South American country.
They said Mikalos, who was being held in a jail in the nearby city of Caltanissetta, was likely to be extradited to Colombia.
